subject: english
question:
**Convert the sentence provided below from its passive voice structure to an active voice structure: **

The allegation that the system had been hacked was denied by the company.

options.text: The company denied that the system had been hacked.
The hacking of the system was denied by the company.
It was denied that the hacking occurred by the company.
The company had denied hacking the system.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The allegation that the system had been hacked was denied by the company."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the company" at the beginning.
 
• Change the verb structure to reflect the active voice: "denied" remains the same.
 
• Ensure that the rest of the sentence ("that the system had been hacked") remains intact.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The company denied that the system had been hacked."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"The company denied that the system had been hacked." – This is the correct active voice conversion.
 
• **Option 2: **"The hacking of the system was denied by the company." – This is a passive voice sentence.
 
• **Option 3: **"It was denied that the hacking occurred by the company." – Incorrect structure and unclear phrasing.
 
• **Option 4: **"The company had denied hacking the system." – This changes the original meaning by altering the verb tense and structure.
